subject: integration
name: Saved passwords standard (PASSWORD_0_1)
summary: The row for the PASSWORD_0_1 standard, which defines the logins saved for websites, listed for the page in front and read to fill a sign-in form; only the browser calls it. A standard defines a code without answering it: the row runs nothing, holds no state and makes no connection, and whatever answers the code is judged on its own row. Open source, and the definition is a JSON file in Orivon's source. Judged here by its publisher.
